title: M6.P2 E700/T44: interface: EmulationStation's vendored libraries, translations and build files
body:
Slice T44, canonical `es-vendored-and-data`, M6.P2 under interface epic #700. Run the proved coordinator brief `docs/reviews/briefs/es-vendored-and-data.md` v2 under plan §6b. D-WORKFLOW-232 fixes the dated source contract; the explicit dispatch supplies the exact distribution seed/worktree pair.

## Scope and source contract

594 native survey keys remain separate from three later accepted T2 root tests (450 lines) and four accepted companion branch records. Survey51fork-own/543upstream-carried and374547inventory lines are dated facts; the gitlink contributes a synthetic line, not source. At accepted T2 ES55158d2a64c69fe295fb4e67fd174424a71b1b4d, native text is374720logical lines;554native identities are unchanged and40changed. The actual root tree is64b90eb8cb07bdfcd690c74ff6bc980ae490657c. The helper compares this root OID directly.

The primary includes PL-024's35PO/37files/38replacements. Later T21/T34/T35 French deltas and T36's zero outside-app/core delta are separate accepted coverage obligations, not a combined tree. Doctest is unchanged vendor import, and pugixml is a gitlink with system selection in the distribution recipe. Read root test/hook code and provenance/build/catalogue/resource interfaces; preserve existing behavior owners. No recut, source change, pin promotion or removal.

Can this be done on the VM? No runtime behavior is proposed: this is a source provenance table. Future behavior/removal proof belongs to an owning fix brief and GENERIC_X64. No compiler/build/guest, source export, config/test/hook execution, fetch, model provider, physical/cloud or host allocation. Public primary release/license pages may inform dated currency; unavailable evidence remains explicit.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] 00–07, stage A–D records/tools and one Local plan exist under the named audit root.
- [ ] Helper output binds six P1 selectors/ledgers, recipe,594 native rows and the complete unchanged primary ES tree to the actual seeds.
- [ ] Survey374547 versus text374546 and primary374720 lines, kinds/modes/gitlink and dated51/543 tiers reconcile; no synthetic source or reading claim.
- [ ] Provenance/Coverage each contain594 unique nonempty native rows; three450-line post-survey tests and four companion branch records stay separate.
- [ ] Nine T20 exclusions and T18/T21/T34/T35/T36/T37 behavior/build boundaries remain explicit with existing owners; no recut or duplicate bug.
- [ ] The40 primary fork-own CODE rows/5017 lines plus450 supplemental lines have a complete reading register; doctest's7134 lines are verified unchanged import, not authored-code credit.
- [ ] PL-024's35PO/37files/38replacements, separate T2 French additions and later6/1/1 entries have exact source evidence; no combined-tree or integrated-key claim.
- [ ] Vendored groups bind import/mode/blob/version/license evidence and carried reasons; dual rcheevos markers, id3v2lib history and pugixml system selection are qualified correctly.
- [ ] Catalogue/resource/build/test tables bind exact source writers/readers/conditions; any syntactic counts have parser limits, failing input and retained raw evidence.
- [ ] Q1–Q7, conformance/doctrine/interactions/self-refutation and prior-evidence comparison are complete; current currency has dated primary evidence or a specific open input.
- [ ] Seven audit-local generator refusals fail and positive passes; exact program/fixture/input/output/exit bindings exist without replaying accepted producers.
- [ ] Actual Local primary/lab/identity source and historical provenance are truthful; reviewers[] and no independent-review claim.
- [ ] Pre-issue lint and, after disposition, both normal/issue resolution lints print their actual PASS; every punch item has an evidenced Phase-7 outcome.
- [ ] Reactive bugs carry trace/Already written/VM rationale and observable criteria; issue checks pass and unresolved bugs remain open.
- [ ] Whole ES seed and distribution source/rules/selector identities remain unchanged; per-commit allowed-record guard and a planted source-edit negative verify confinement.
- [ ] Census/retirement names only receipt-bound owned scratch; no runtime/provider/host/device/cloud action, source export, accepted replay or permission relay.
- [ ] Rules/register/index/ceremony/forbidden/hooks checks and exact tracker readbacks pass with actual exits; final publication binds the clean final tip and unchanged ES seed.
- [ ] Posted retro and final handback retain outcomes, friction, next owners, companion-integration limits and unmeasured time-to-play.
- [ ] reviewed-at/fixed-at bind distribution seed/final and reviewed-at-es/fixed-at-es both bind55158; a separate companion manifest names four accepted refs. Area integration remains future work.
- [ ] Root verifies new integration/record gates and final acceptance; completion marker follows acceptance and slice closure/status follows actual ordered area integration.

## Execution boundary

Existing T2 executes A–D continuously only after explicit dispatch naming both fresh worktrees and exact seeds. Stop at clean published D for root stream disposition; no per-stage approval relay. Local actual primary/lab/identity source, reviewers[]. Root retains planning, criteria, acceptance, audit closure/completion and ordered area integration. All audit changes are distribution records; the entire ES tree stays at its accepted T2 seed. Historical launch and accepted audit trees remain untouched.

D-WORKFLOW-190 permits independent different-area T43 record work beside T44; no T43 final-acceptance gate is invented. T46 remains last. Keep source/record subprocesses on CPUs8–23, and never answer another agent's permission prompt.
